question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Do Sara and Nick make a good couple?
Which part of the night did you like best?

labels: Let him stick up for himself!

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Meh. Don't worry about it! Eat it! Eat it!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Chanting? I love chanting! Eat it! Eat it!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Eat it! Eat it!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well, you heard the guys.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Do you think it has too much sugar in it?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Nice. Going with the healthy option...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: It's not really healthy...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It has more protein than a candy bar!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But it also has a lot of fat, right?
At the pool hall's diner, the group slides into a big booth and looks at menus.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey guys... Look! This place is the home of the Biggest Belly Burger!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: It says if you can eat their king-sized burger, your table gets free fries!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey, girls... Bet you can't eat one of these...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Ugh, do you want me to waddle home? No way!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: But I bet Sara can.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Yeah, I've seen your lunch. It's huge!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You could totally eat a tiny little burger like this.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't think something called the 'Biggest Belly Burger' is `tiny.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I don't think something called the 'Biggest Belly Burger' is [color=#3b78e2][i]tiny.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sara looks down at the menu.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Maybe I can get away with a small slice of pie?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: You mean their mile-high mud pie?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sure... I've never had it before...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: What? It's like you haven't lived! So much chocolate! So good!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I probably shouldn't eat anything really... My dad wouldn't approve.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Which means this is your chance! You should totally get something that you'd never eat in front of him!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: ...Wait, what are we talking about?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Eat the pie, Sara. You only live once, right?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: No, Sara. Eat the burger. If you finish, `everyone` gets free fries!
nodes.text_bbcode: No, Sara. Eat the burger. If you finish, [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone[/i][/color] gets free fries!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: If I'm going to eat anything, it's going to be...
Sara jolts, pushing Cameron back, just as she takes the shot!
The cue ball jumps off the table!
Cameron scowls as Hannah and Zach laugh.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wrap this up, Zach.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Whatever you say, hotshot.
Zach takes his shot and sinks the eight ball.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Too bad we didn't bet on this game!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: 'Cuz if we had... You would have lost!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Go shove yourself.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Oh, I will! Straight into some victory fries! What do you say, Hannah?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Diner's that way.
Zach slings an arm around Hannah, and together, they walk to the pool hall's restaurant.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sorry... I was kind of skittish. I don't know why.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You don't like me much, do you?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hey, it's not like that. I'm just bad at pool.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Uh-huh. Sure. Come on, Machine. I'll buy you a soda.
Cameron walks after Zach and Hannah.
Sara fights the urge to move away from him and relaxes.
With Cameron's help, Sara follows through and sinks the shot!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I believe that's game.
Cameron raises his hand, and Sara high-fives it.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So you weren't all talk after all, Cameron.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You know, I think we're a pretty good team.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, we are.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Ugh, barf. I'm done here... You saps want to get some food at the diner? I'm hungry.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: As much as I'd like to keep joking around...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Time's a wasting. Let's get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Finally!
Everyone turns to leave except Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You're not coming?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Do you want me to?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I want him to come, but I don't want to push him into it...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I mean, everyone else is doing it, and it'd be a lot of fun.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: How many times do you get to sneak around like this?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: As a journalist? More times than you'd think...
Cameron steps in between them.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Leave him alone, Sara. He's clearly not interested...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Even if he's not a swimmer, he's still an important part of the team.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You shouldn't make fun of him.
Nick flashes her a grateful smile.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: What? Me make fun of him?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'd never do that. It's just friendly, Sara.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I'm always trying to be friends with this guy.
Cameron punches Nick playfully in the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Aren't I?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You have a funny way of showing it.
Sara says nothing.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Really, Nick, it's not like you're an athlete or anything.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I am too!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Oh yeah?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You know that photography isn't a sport, right?

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I don't know, Cameron... That camera of his has got to weigh at least ten pounds...
The guys laugh as Nick's face turns red.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I should have said something for him...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's her choice, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Are you ready? Let's get out of here!
Hannah heads to the window and opens it.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Wait, Hannah! What about Officer Monte? You know, blue uniform, evil eye, weirdly attached to his moustache?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, he's supposed to be walking up and down the halls, isn't he?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: If he catches us, he'll just report us to Sara's dad.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Come on, you guys... Office Monte's easy to deal with.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: That wasn't the impression I got...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: He's a total softie!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: He is?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Look, if you're really worried about getting caught... Just do exactly as I say...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: When Monte catches you, `start crying immediately.` That'll soften him up.
nodes.text_bbcode: When Monte catches you, [color=#3b78e2][i]start crying immediately.[/i][/color] That'll soften him up.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Next, whatever you do... Don't apologize. He doesn't like it when people say 'sorry'.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Just tell him that you're `guilty.`
nodes.text_bbcode: Just tell him that you're [color=#3b78e2][i]guilty.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: And then what? What's to stop him from turning us in?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Tell him `why` you were sneaking out. Give him a good reason, something he'll sympathize with.
nodes.text_bbcode: Tell him [color=#3b78e2][i]why[/i][/color] you were sneaking out. Give him a good reason, something he'll sympathize with.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Like what?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: 'Officer, I was sneaking out because I heard there was a police charity fashion show... It's for the good of law enforcement!'

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: He'll really fall for that?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Works like a charm. After that, he'll feel sorry for you, and then he'll give you a long lecture about being responsible or whatever.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: As long as you keep your eyes `on the floor`, he'll send you back to your room. Safe, sound, and not in trouble.
nodes.text_bbcode: As long as you keep your eyes [color=#3b78e2][i]on the floor[/i][/color], he'll send you back to your room. Safe, sound, and not in trouble.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Got it? Now let's move!
The girls follow Hannah outside and through the hotel.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Where are we going? The hotel entrance is the other way!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, and the boys' room is `this` way!
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, and the boys' room is [color=#3b78e2][i]this[/i][/color] way!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: How do you know that?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I saw the room number on the keys. Geez, don't you pay attention to anything?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I had a feeling you were up to something...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Why do we need the boys anyway?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Yeah, I agree. I don't trust them. `Especially` that Cameron guy. He's definitely a womanizer.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah, I agree. I don't trust them. [color=#3b78e2][i]Especially[/i][/color] that Cameron guy. He's definitely a womanizer.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: For once in your lives, can you guys just go along with the plan? We could go without the boys...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: But it'll be so much more fun if they come!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Come on, it's just a quick stop!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Ugh, fine.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Whee!
The girls walk down the path and knock on a door. Zach opens it.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Hey, laaadies... Come on in...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I'd rather stay outside, thanks.
Hannah pushes Jane into the room. Sara and Amanda follow.
On the small TV, Lee and Cameron are playing video games. Nick is lounging on the bed, reading.
When the girls enter, Cameron puts his controller down and smiles at them.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: You're going down in flames, Cameron!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I've found something more important to do.
Cameron walks up to the girls. He winks at Sara.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey, hey... What are you girls doing here?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Is that any of your business?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You're the ones who turned up at our door.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: And we're looking for a night of fun. There's a pool hall around here that has our names all over it.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I didn't know I owned a pool!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Anyway, are you guys in?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Definitely. Besides, I can't say 'no' to a bunch of hot girls, can I?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: No, you really can't.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Neither can I!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Then we're on. Let's go.
As Zach, Cameron, and Lee prepare to go, Nick gets off the bed.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Wait, are you all leaving the hotel?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah. Aren't you coming?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't think so...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Are you sure? Officer Monte's already gone.
Cameron frowns at the two of them.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: You can stay in if you want, Nick.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I just don't want to get in trouble. And I don't want any of you to either.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Relax, man. Live a little.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But what about the competition tomorrow?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Why should you care about the competition? You're just taking pictures anyway.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I think that hurt Nick's feelings...

options.label: Let him stick up for himself!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sure... What's a little change of pace?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yes!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Then I'm in! We `have` to find a hot tub!
nodes.text_bbcode: Then I'm in! We [color=#3b78e2][i]have[/i][/color] to find a hot tub!

nodes.text: Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sounds good to me.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Me too!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Ugh, you can count me out.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm not going to go if `she's` going.
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not going to go if [color=#3b78e2][i]she's[/i][/color] going.

nodes.text: Sam points at Sara for emphasis.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Oh, Sam... Don't be like that.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We're not going to leave you behind.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Too bad.
Sam goes into the bathroom and slams the door.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Suit yourself.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'll just go out alone.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Some team.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Wait, wait... I'll go with you.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Me too!
Sam looks from Sara to Hannah.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Well, there's no way I'm staying here. I'm in.
They leave, and Sara is alone in their hotel room.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I guess I'll just go to bed then...
Sara climbs into bed and falls asleep...
Early the next morning, Sara awakes to the opening door and the sound of laughter.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What... What time is it?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Go back to bed, old lady.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Oh, man, Sam... Going out last night was so fun!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I can't believe we saw Hawk Gunner! And remember the purple parrot?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You found a purple parrot?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: No... It was... A...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: It wasn't `really` purple!
nodes.text_bbcode: It wasn't [color=#3b78e2][i]really[/i][/color] purple!

nodes.text: Everyone else bursts into giggles...
Sara has never felt more alone.
Looks like Sara's feeling more down than ever! Sometimes, it's worth going on an adventure...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thanks, Amanda. But it doesn't matter.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I couldn't date him even if I wanted to. My dad is too serious about my swimming.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I can't even think about what he'd do if he ever found out about me dating.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: There's your first problem! You think too much!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah well... I just hope I can figure everything out before I get crushed at tomorrow's race.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Crushing is fun! I do it all the time!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Or at least... I did before Hector!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't think we're talking about the same thing...
That night...
The swim team stands in their hotel's outdoor corridors as they wait for Coach Kessler to check them in.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right, boys and girls... I've got the keys.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Once you get to your rooms, you prepare for bed and get some rest. You do not leave your rooms!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: The tournament starts early tomorrow. I expect everyone to be downstairs at 7:30 sharp, so that we can grab breakfast and check in on time.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Officer Monte has volunteered to keep watch to make sure no one is fooling around in the middle of the night.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: If I find out any of you have snuck out, I will contact your parents and the school.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You got it?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yes, Coach.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: Sure thing, Coach.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Good.
The girls step into their hotel room...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Ooh! It smells like a hotel!
Sara sets her stuff down on one of the beds and looks around.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Dibs on the bed near the window.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You can't call 'dibs'!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I just did, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Hey guys, there's no point in fighting because none of you should plan on sleeping.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Oh really? What do you mean by that?

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We are going to sneak out!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Not this again...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Are you kidding me? The swim finals are tomorrow!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Come on, Jane. This is probably the first time you've been out from under your mother's thumb...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: So live a little!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We're just going to go have fun for a little bit... And we'll come back, get some sleep, and kick butt tomorrow.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Besides, you're the one who said hot tubbing would be awesome. We're not going to get the chance staying in.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hannah, last time we snuck out, it was a disaster...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Which means you have to come out. It's your second chance! Amanda, what about you?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I'll go if more people go...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: `Linda` would have gone with me. She's not lame like everyone else...
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Linda[/i][/color] would have gone with me. She's not lame like everyone else...

nodes.text: Hannah turns to Sara and shoots her a pleading look.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You're my last hope. Come on, Sara...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Has she done something to you?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No. It's more like I've done something to her.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: All the rumors about that photo of me and Nick caused Sam to break up with him.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I feel really bad about it...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So bad that I told Nick I couldn't date him.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But even then, I still think about him.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, of course you do. I think about things I feel guilty about all the time.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Those poor cookies...
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Even though I'm not sure Amanda understands... It feels good to get it out...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, you shouldn't feel too bad. You can't help how you feel.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sometimes these things happen for a reason. You should probably just go for it.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Or someone else might eat it, and then where would you be?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Nick told me he liked me last month, and I told him to stay away.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh... Is something wrong with him? Like, is his face too hairy?!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Because that would creep me out.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No, it's not that...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh, do his glasses make his eyes too big?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh, not that I've noticed...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Does he become a monster at night?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I hope not...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: So... It doesn't really sound like anything's wrong with him...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: So why'd you tell him to go away? If you're thinking about him all the time, then maybe you should go after him!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Or at least flirt with him? Flirting doesn't count if no one else is looking.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I guess I feel guilty. I broke Sam and Nick up, you know.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Sounds like it's more about Sam than it is about Nick.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah... Maybe it is.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Well, maybe you should just let it all go.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: If you two are meant to be... Things will work out.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Anyway... We need to get out of here.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Hit the showers.
Sara trudges towards the locker rooms.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I want to win this race...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I won't be able to do that until I figure out whatever it is I'm feeling about Nick!
Later that day, the members of the boys' and girls' swim team sit boisterously in a bus!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: All right, quiet down!
The swim team quiets.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Your bus driver and trip chaperone has a few words to say before we take off.
Coach Kessler gestures to their bus driver, Officer Monte.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Listen up, young scrubs. You may be athletes in a fine aquatic sport...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But if I see any lolly-gaggering, holler-tattering, or folly-shantering, I will stop this bus!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: If you so much as make one of my moustache hairs quiver, we will go no further!
Monte sits down, and the bus starts its trip.
In her seat, Sara slumps. She's the only one sitting alone. Around her, everyone is having fun talking.
In front, the swim team guys jostle each other.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Hey, Zach... Bet you can't stuff this granola bar in your mouth.

nodes.speaker: Lee
nodes.text: I bet he can't stuff `five` in his mouth!
nodes.text_bbcode: I bet he can't stuff [color=#e23b3b][i]five[/i][/color] in his mouth!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: I've got six in my mouth right now!
A couple rows behind Sara, the other girls talk.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I wonder if our hotel has a hot tub...

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I could totally use a soak in a hot tub. That sounds amazing!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah... Just as long as we don't have to do laps in it!
The girls laugh.
Sara peeks around her seat to where Nick is sitting by himself, looking out the window.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I can't believe the newspaper club sent `Nick` to report on the swim finals...
nodes.text_bbcode: I can't believe the newspaper club sent [color=#3b78e2][i]Nick[/i][/color] to report on the swim finals...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Of all people...
Suddenly, she feels a tap on her shoulder. She turns and finds Amanda in the aisle.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Hey, is this seat taken?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Nope. Go ahead.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Thanks! I'm Amanda!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I know. We met when I sat at the Center Table. And we met again the day you joined the swim team...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And about ten minutes ago when we were getting on the bus...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Oh yeah! I forgot!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: But yay! I just remembered!
As Amanda hums a happy tune to herself, Sara looks at the back of the bus and accidentally catches Sam's eye.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: What do `you` want?
nodes.text_bbcode: What do [color=#3b78e2][i]you[/i][/color] want?

nodes.text: Sara immediately faces forward again and slumps further down in her seat.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Is something wrong? I hate it when something's wrong!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well... I've been having a hard time lately.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Have you tried using pillows?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Uh, no...

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: What are you so sad about then?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I haven't been swimming at my best lately. I've been too distracted.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: By what?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Honestly, it's because of...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: The high schooler who broke the national record did it in `28.5` seconds.
nodes.text_bbcode: The high schooler who broke the national record did it in [color=#e23b3b][i]28.5[/i][/color] seconds.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: She always said she would 'do her best'.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: So that's the right attitude at least.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: But it's hard to feel confident that you'll beat her when you've been performing so poorly.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Try to put all the practice races out of your head and concentrate on tomorrow.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I will... `Coach.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I will... [color=#3b78e2][i]Coach.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I thought you said it was 'nothing'.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah. Nothing that you'd understand.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: What I `do` understand is that you need to get whatever's bothering you out of your head.
nodes.text_bbcode: What I [color=#e23b3b][i]do[/i][/color] understand is that you need to get whatever's bothering you out of your head.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: The high schooler who broke the national record did it in `28.5` seconds.
nodes.text_bbcode: The high schooler who broke the national record did it in [color=#e23b3b][i]28.5[/i][/color] seconds.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Do you think she had something on her mind? Of course she did!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: But she put it `aside.`
nodes.text_bbcode: But she put it [color=#e23b3b][i]aside.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: If you want to beat her time, you're going to have to do the same.
Sara can't concentrate! Her focus slips, and she slows in the water.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm falling behind!
Sara surfaces. Her father looms over her, staring angrily down.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: That was worse than last time!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: We're about to hop on a bus to Prosperpine, and you're barely ready to `finish` a race, much less `win` one!
nodes.text_bbcode: We're about to hop on a bus to Prosperpine, and you're barely ready to [color=#e23b3b][i]finish[/i][/color] a race, much less [color=#e23b3b][i]win[/i][/color] one!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I don't want you to be sorry... I want you to be motivated.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: If you manage to set a record here, people will notice you. `Important people.`
nodes.text_bbcode: If you manage to set a record here, people will notice you. [color=#e23b3b][i]Important people.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: So you need to bring your 'A' game to this match, you understand?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I understand...

options.label: I promise to do my best!
I just have a lot on my mind!

nodes.text: Sara catches the ledge and pulls herself up!

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Perfect 10.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thanks.
She hops down on the other side, and together, the group walks into the aquatic center.

nodes.text: As Sara settles into her starting position, she scans the crowd...
She sees Hannah, Jane, and Amanda cheering her on from the sidelines.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, Sara!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Go, Sara! Knock 'em dead!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Break a fin!
And in the bleachers, Sara sees Nick, camera in hand.
He points at his camera and flashes her a thumbs-up.
At last, her gaze lands on her dad. He gives her a curt nod, and she positions herself on the starting block.
When the bell rings signaling the beginning of the match, she glides smoothly into the water.
Nothing weighing or holding her down, Sara feels like she's flying through the waves.
And when she touches the line, she knows it's the fastest she's ever been.
Sara climbs out of the pool, and every reporter in the audience, including Nick, is rapidly taking pictures.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Whoa... This is weird...
Sara shields her eyes as Coach Kessler and her teammates crowd around her.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: You were amazing!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: I can't believe it...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What's wrong? Did I lose?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Maybe? I don't know, but your time was so low!

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Look at the board, sweetheart.
He points up at the board where all the swimmers' times have been posted.
In the number one slot is the name 'Sara Kessler, 50m Backstroke', and next to it, is her time of `28.3` seconds.
nodes.text_bbcode: In the number one slot is the name 'Sara Kessler, 50m Backstroke', and next to it, is her time of [b]28.3[/b] seconds.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I... I... Did it! I broke the `national record!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I... I... Did it! I broke the [color=#3b78e2][i]national record![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Coach Kessler hugs his daughter as the cameras snap.
Wow! Sara managed to concentrate on what's truly important, get together with Nick, and break a record!
You did a great job!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.text: Sara gets into her starting position, but finds her body stiff and sore.
As she waits for the buzzer, her vision blurs, and she can feel her head pound.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I definitely stayed out too late... I've never felt so bad before a swim in my life...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I hope Nick wasn't too mad that we left him last night...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Nick...
Sara dwells on her memories of him too long. When the buzzer goes off, she's not ready!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Ah!
She starts swimming a full second behind everyone else. And when she places her hand on the wall, she finishes last.
She climbs out of the pool, her head pounding worse than ever.
She watches the first place swimmer smile for the local press.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I could have beat her, I know it...
Over on the sidelines, Sara sees Sam and Nick talking, smiling with one another.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, Sara!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sam, you haven't talked to me in days! What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm just not that mad at you anymore...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: And great news...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Nick and I went on a walk last night and ran into each other and started talking again.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: We're not quite dating yet, but we're going to try again.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Yeah... We're going to give it another shot.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh... That's, uh... That's great.
Sara turns away from them, her heart heavy in her chest, as Nick and Sam take each other's hand.
Coach Kessler charges over to her.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Please don't say anything...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: You expect me not to comment on your performance?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Sara, you were unprepared, unfocused, and undisciplined!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Dad, I...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I don't know whether to crack down on you or quit on you entirely!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Dad... I didn't get that much sleep last night... I've been so stressed...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Yes, I know that much. Swimming competitively isn't easy.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: But I really expected you to pull through.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: The fact that you didn't makes me think you're not the athlete that I thought you were.
Coach Kessler walks away, and Sara hangs her head.
Okay, `that` didn't turn out well at all! Sam and Nick got back together, Sara lost, and Coach Kessler's so angry with her that he's ready to quit?
nodes.text_bbcode: Okay, [b]that[/b] didn't turn out well at all! Sam and Nick got back together, Sara lost, and Coach Kessler's so angry with her that he's ready to quit?

nodes.text: This seems like the bad ending!
Try again and see if you can help Sara figure out all her problems in time for the race!

args.text: Surviving High School
Thanks for playing!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: They prove that you could be so much more than a swimmer.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: They're all the ways that you're you. Sara Kessler. Member of the swim team, Homecoming Princess, Presidential Candidate, and a fine friend.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I don't want to seem like a creepy stalker or anything, but you're the subject of these pictures because you're lively, vibrant, and beautiful...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You don't have to be defined by what your dad says.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: You can be a swimmer... But you can be so much more.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thanks, Nick...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And on that note, there's something I've been wanting to tell you.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I really like you, and despite what I said before... I'm ready to try 'us' out.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I mean, if you still want to.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I like the sound of that.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But what about your dad?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You said it yourself. My dad doesn't define who I am. Besides, I might have been using him as an excuse.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: An excuse for what?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Because I'm scared. Maybe I can be a Princess, or a President, or a friend...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I don't know anything about being a girlfriend...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: It's not like I have the greatest track record either.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But we can figure it out together.
Underneath a flowering tree, Nick draws Sara close. They share a kiss under the stars.
Neither of them notices the shadowy figure move off the path and streak back into the girls' room.
But then again, neither pulls away for a very long time.
The next morning, at the swim meet...

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Welcome to this next heat of the Prosperpine High School Swim Finals!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: For those of you who just joined, we're pitting the top three schools in the county against one another for the championship prize!

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Swimmers participating in the Women's 50m Backstroke, please take your places.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Actually no...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I'm kind of using them for the yearbook, so I need those back.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I could get fired for losing them.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You know that the newspaper is not `actually` a job you can be fired from.
nodes.text_bbcode: You know that the newspaper is not [color=#3b78e2][i]actually[/i][/color] a job you can be fired from.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Okay, so it wouldn't be as bad as all that. But I'd get into a lot of trouble.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Think about it. It'd be a tragedy. If I lost these photos, there'd be no pictures of you in the yearbook.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So tragedy aside, why did you show me the pictures?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Because the pictures prove my point.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Ding ding, I think she's got it.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You are so cheesy sometimes.
Nick shrugs.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So what are these pictures supposed to tell me?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And don't say 'model' because honestly, I don't think I can give up one high-pressure career for another.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Let me start by saying that you `could` be a model...
nodes.text_bbcode: Let me start by saying that you [color=#e23b3b][i]could[/i][/color] be a model...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Thank you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: But these pictures prove a different point.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What are you doing out here?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Going for a walk. To clear my head.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: What's up? I thought you were out with Zach Jock, Lee Trust Fund, and Cameron Swimmer Guy.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'd rather be with Nick Photographer. Can I walk with you?
Nick nods, and they start walking down a path to the hotel gardens.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: So... What's up with you? We haven't really talked since, uh, `that` day.
nodes.text_bbcode: So... What's up with you? We haven't really talked since, uh, [color=#e23b3b][i]that[/i][/color] day.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: The day I lost the Presidency and one of my best friends?

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Well, when you put it that way, it sounds really dramatic.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I guess what I'm trying to say is that I miss hanging out with you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I miss you too.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Here, I want to show you something.
From his pocket, Nick hands her a stack of photographs.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Maybe you should be Nick Stalker.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Hey, I'm the school photographer. I have pictures of everything.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Take a look.
Sara flips through the pictures.
There's one of her eating happily with the swim team in the cafeteria. Her eyes are bright, and she's smiling widely.
Another picture shows her looking outraged onstage during her Presidential interview with Andrew.
She flips through more and finds a picture of her on a school picnic, surrounded by friends and Nick.
The last picture shows her sitting in a dance chair after the announcement of Homecoming Queen.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hey, you weren't here for the Homecoming Dance...

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: I found it in the archives and brought it here for you.

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sara, do you know why I showed you all these pictures?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Because...

options.label: You want me to keep them.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Are you going to tell my dad?

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I should...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But you snuck out for the love of moustaches...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Which I understand.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Get back into your room quick. And don't leave it for the rest of the night!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yes, Officer.
Sara waves good-bye to Monte and heads up to her room.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm so glad that worked!
Up in the hotel, Sara lets herself into her room and prepares for sleep.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Time to go to sleep... Hopefully, I'll swim well tomorrow...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: We're going right now!
He strides down the hall, but Sara catches up with him.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Please don't do this...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Haven't you broken a law for the love of moustaches?
Monte's moustache quivers in sympathy, and he stops.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Fine. I won't tell him.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But I am going to keep an extra eye out on your room! No more sneaking out!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yes, sir.
Monte escorts Sara through the hotel to her room.
Sara walks inside and closes the door behind her.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: At least he's not going to tell my dad!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I'm a nervous wreck!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hopefully, this will all look better in the morning...
Immediately, he bristles. His moustache shakes angrily.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: First, you sneak out...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Next, you challenge my authority!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No! I...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Shoot! Hannah told me to look down!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm sorry! Really!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: And I see now... I know why I shouldn't leave my room.
After several minutes, Monte heaves a huge sigh.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now do you understand why sneaking out can ruin your life?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yes, sir.
Sara doesn't dare look up.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I guess you do. You're ashamed, I can see it.
Sara nods vigorously.
Unsure what to do, Sara looks up into Monte's eyes.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: All I wanted to do was go to a convention...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Oh really? You're not going to that pool hall all the younglings in this area seem to be going to?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No way! That sounds really boring! I was actually interested in going to a `moustache convention` that's just around the corner.
nodes.text_bbcode: No way! That sounds really boring! I was actually interested in going to a [color=#3b78e2][i]moustache convention[/i][/color] that's just around the corner.

nodes.text: Monte's moustache quirks.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: The Coiffure Committee did say it was having its annual meet-up near here...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Jackpot!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Exactly, sir.
Monte turns to her angrily.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: While your loyalty to moustaches is admirable...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: That excuse isn't good enough for you to be wandering out here...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Do you have any idea how irresponsible it is for you to be outside right now?! There are hoodlums everywhere!
Monte starts going off on an angry tirade.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hannah said I had to do something here...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You should be!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But I'm not the one you should be apologizing to.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: And it's high time I've shown you to your dad.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: No! Wait!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Excuse me?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't have any excuses. I'm guilty of sneaking out.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I know it.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I admire a perp who admits their wrongdoing. Shows they've got a conscience.
Sara stutters.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Speak up, girl! You're tongue-tied is what you are!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm sorry!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm... I'm really...
Sara bites down on her lip so hard, tears start to form at the corners of her eyes.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sniff... Sniff...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Hey, wait... Don't do that...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: I'm just going to take you to your father.
Sara wails.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sniff... Sniff... Please don't!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Uh, hush up...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sniff... Sniff...
He awkwardly pats Sara on the shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Fine. I won't take you to your father!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: There, there, take it easy.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: So far, so good...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Now, tell me... What are you doing out of your room?
Sara kicks herself hard!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Ow!
She falls to the floor, clinging to her leg. Above her, Monte eyes her skeptically.

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Quit the shenanigans...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: What are you even doing out here?!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: When your father hears about this...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh, no, please don't tell my dad! You... You just can't!

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: You're barely older than my moustache! You can't tell me what to do!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Just... Just let me explain!
Sara freezes, unsure what to do!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yes... I am having fun. Let's stay out longer.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah! I have just the place I want to go!
Hannah drags them into a nearby tattoo parlor.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I don't like the look of this place.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Give it a chance. Since we've joined the swim team, we've all become so close.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: We should get tattoos to show what a great team we are!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I'm thinking something water-related... A tear drop? Or maybe a swimsuit?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: A pony!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: No, no, and definitely not.

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: If I'm going to mark my body, I want to make sure I'm getting something I won't regret.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Okay, Jane. What would you want?
Hannah pushes a book of tattoos at the girls.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Wait, I got it. We don't need an image at all. Let's get a phrase that means something to all of us!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Like 'Swimmer for Life'!

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: Okay... That doesn't sound too bad. I could commit to that.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Yeah!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hannah, I can't do this. My dad would kill me.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Yeah, yeah, and he'd kill you for being out of your room past curfew.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: But don't listen to him. Let's make this your night for defying him.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: In fact... You should go first. To show that he doesn't own you.
Sara takes a deep breath.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Okay. I could do that. Maybe if it's really small, it could go on my back.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: At least my swimsuit would still hide it.
Sara hesitantly puts herself in the chair.
The tattoo artist begins his work, and some time later, Sara gets the phrase emblazoned across her skin.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Ow, ow, ow, ow!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: This hurts!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: It's not a sticker. This is the real thing. Of course it hurts!
At last, Sara steps out of the chair, surveying her new tattoo.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: There, done! Who's next?

nodes.speaker: Jane
nodes.text: You looked like you were in real pain... I don't know if I can get a tattoo after what you went through.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I feel sick...
Sara sees that Amanda has turned a greenish color.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm starting to know how you feel.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Well, Hannah... This was your idea...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I know I said it was great, but... On second thought, it's not my brightest idea.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Hannah!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Plus, your tattoo says 'Always a `Simmer'.` He forgot the 'w'!
nodes.text_bbcode: Plus, your tattoo says 'Always a [color=#3b78e2][i]Simmer'.[/i][/color] He forgot the 'w'!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What?! Why didn't you tell him when he was `tattooing` it on my body?!
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! Why didn't you tell him when he was [color=#3b78e2][i]tattooing[/i][/color] it on my body?!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: I just noticed!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Are you getting a tattoo?!

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Well... Not after he made the mistake on yours...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: `Hannah!!!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]Hannah!!![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Poor Sara! She's stuck with a tattoo that doesn't even make sense!
Maybe she should have stayed in when she had the chance. Try again and see if you can get Sara on the right path!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: You know what? I've had enough fun for one night...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Sorry, guys, but I need to turn in.
Sara stifles a huge yawn.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Looks like I made the right move...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Anyone else want to walk back to the rooms?
Most of the group shakes their head.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Cameron?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Nope, I'm staying out.
He turns to Jane and starts talking with her.
Sara walks away from the group, shaking her head.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Is it me, or did Cameron suddenly get really distant?
Before Sara can say anything else, Hannah comes up to them.

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Zach and I are bored. We want to go somewhere else. You in?
Sara yawns.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's getting kind of late...

nodes.speaker: Hannah
nodes.text: Don't quit on me now! You've been having fun so far...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Maybe I'm starting to see that now.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: There's someone that I like a lot... But I can't be with him.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: There it is.
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Maybe I'm using my dad as an excuse, but it's getting harder to ignore how I feel about him.

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Who's the guy?

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Not that I `care,` or anything.
nodes.text_bbcode: Not that I [color=#e23b3b][i]care,[/i][/color] or anything.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'm not ready to tell you `that.`
nodes.text_bbcode: I'm not ready to tell you [color=#3b78e2][i]that.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: Okay.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's just that it seems so hard to be with this guy. Not just because of my dad, but because I want to take my swimming seriously...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: I used to be really serious about swimming, but then I met a girl I liked...

nodes.speaker: Cameron
nodes.text: And I realized that my life didn't have to be `all` about swimming. It's still important, but it's not everything.

Zoe
Super New Girl: The Complete Saga
What happens when your favorite new girl gets super-powered?
You get daunting cheerleading trials...
Listen, new girl... If you want our favor for the cheerleading squad, then all you have to do is prove one thing to us.
You have to prove your worth on the field of battle! In a fight to the death!
No pressure or anything...
Fiery family drama...
It's `great` to have you here again, Cousin $ZOE...
It was `so` much fun hanging out when we were little... I'm sure it'll be just like old times.
That's when $SUPERZOE notices the swirls of heat rise from Sam's hands. In a moment, there are tiny flames at the tips of Sam's fingers!
Uh... Your hands are on fire...
A thrilling new romance...
Ready?
Where are we going?
Up.
Howard and $SUPERZOE zoom up, up, and away into the clouds...
And super-powered enemies!
What I've heard is true? The Dreadlord of Doomsday has returned?
I'm afraid so...
Then this is a dark day.
Follow the Super New Girl on a whole new kind of adventure!
When an evil force threatens everything $SUPERZOE holds dear...
It's going to take all her power...
A circle of earthen spears punch upward through the turf, completely surrounding $SUPERZOE! The spears harden from sand into translucent glass!
As they do, they move inward, forming a tighter and tighter cage!
Oh no! Once that sand fully hardens into glass, it'll be too strong to break with my force field!
I have to act fast!
$SUPERZOE grits her teeth, concentrates, and projects her force field outward...
All her friends...
You can count on me, Professor!
I'm coming too!
Me three!
Me four is less than five!
And all her courage...
Haha, losers... The big boss man, The Dreadlord of Doomsday, is here! Now you're really going to get it!
Chad tilts his head skyward, and $SUPERZOE follows his gaze. A man in a suit descends from above, his path placing him momentarily between $SUPERZOE and the sun...
As his shadow flickers over her, she shivers, consumed by a sudden chill...
For $SUPERZOE to save the day!
$SUPERZOE, here's the deal. Hector, Amanda, and I can take his minions! You make a run at The Dreadlord of Doomsday!
Works for me... `RRRROWWRR!!!`
Hector transforms into a mountain lion, jumps up, and grabs Hawk in his jaws! They crash through the wall of the auditorium!
HAAWWWKKAAA!!!
Sam's body erupts into flame, and the vines choking her burn away to cinders! Paula recoils as if slapped!
Sam seizes Paula by the wrist and flies them both out the ragged, newly-made exit hole!
Amanda reaches out and grabs Spike by the collar. He chars her with flame, but the heat doesn't even sizzle her eyebrows.
Hector... Hector, wait for me!
$SUPERZOE turns to the stage where The Dreadlord of Doomsday waits.
Dreadlord of Doomsday
It's time for you to face my star pupils!
He motions toward a platform on the far side of the stage.
Beth leaps down from the stage and saunters slyly up to $SUPERZOE.
I guess it's just you and me, New Girl. Do you really think you can handle my `purr`fect fighting technique?
Just try me!

Sara might have gone to bed early, but not everyone was as good!
Wonder what Hannah and everyone else got up to later that evening?
Let's check it out!
You know what? I've had enough fun for one night...
Sorry, guys, but I need to turn in.
Sara yawns and turns back towards her hotel room. Hannah shrugs.
Her loss. Come on, I'm starving. Let's get something to eat!
Hannah, Zach, Lee, and Amanda take off.
Behind them, Jane and Cameron lag.
What are you looking at?
Just wondering if you were going with them.
Why? Does that determine what you're going to do?
Yeah, actually.
Why?
Well, you seem to have a bad impression of me.
And I can't have that. If we spent some time hanging out...
You think you're going to convince me that you're not that bad once I get to know you?
It's cliche, but it's true.
Come along, and you can tell me all about how the media portrays women as vessels incapable of independent thought.
...You have been listening to me!
I'm a smart guy.
All right... I'll go.
Together, they follow Hannah and the group.
We never get to eat this much in cheerleading.
That's why swimming's awesome!
They're shown to a table.
Hey, guys... Don't look now, but I think I see Hawk Gunner!
Inside?
Where?
Hannah points in his direction.
The Hawk requires a waiter. Quickly! The Hawk waits for no man!
Gasp! It is him! I can't believe it!
I'm going to get his autograph...
I'm going with you. I don't trust that guy.
They walk over to Hawk's table.
Hawk Gunner! I'm a big fan. Can I get your signature?
The Hawk will do anything for a chick-ling like you...
Where do you want me to sign, chickadee?
Uh... I don't have anything...
Hannah takes a napkin from the table.
What about this?
The Hawk does not sign `napkins`...
Oh...
Uh...
But Hawk will sign `body parts`...
Ew... Not when you say it like that...
How about this? Why don't you come over and hang out... In my nest?
No, that's okay...
Hawk puts his hand on hers.
It'll be a Hawk-casion to remember...
Okay, that's it... She said no, man!
Zach tackles Hawk to the ground. When he stands up again, he grins at Hannah.
That tool was totally asking for it!
That tool is right behind you! Duck!
Hawk charges into Zach!
They crash into a table nearby, causing plates, glasses, and food to crash to the floor!
Zach!
Zach and Hawk pop right back up!
`Zach Attack!`
`Hawk-ah!`
Check, please!
I can't believe we got kicked out of the restaurant for rowdy behavior...
I wasn't even protesting!
Okay, so that part sucked.
But who saw Zach try to get into a fight with Hawk just for me?
I did! I saw it!
Can we just forget that part of the evening ever happened? What are we doing next?
Anyone feel like taking a midnight swim in the lake?
Later on in the woods...
The swimmers huddle around a fire, trying to get warm.
Whoo! Jumping in the lake was intense!
Dude, that was `cold.`
I'm pretty sure I saw ice in that water...
I can't feel my legs... Are they gone?
Well, `I'm` glad I went. Good idea, Hannah.
Aww, thanks, Zach...
Hey, uh, Hannah... You're kind of cool... Maybe you want to, you know, hang out sometime?
We are hanging out.
I mean, when we're actually at school.
We hang out at school too...
I mean... Like on a date.
Geez, I know that. I was kidding. You're too easy.
But what about the 'date' part?
Yeah. That sounds good to me.
Zach puts an arm around her and pulls her closer.
Meanwhile, Lee and Amanda warm their hands by the fire and talk.
So, uh, Amanda... You're, uh... On both the cheerleading team and the swimming team?
Weird, isn't it?
It's like I'm in two different places at once!
Uh, yeah, something like that, I guess.
And elsewhere, a small ways away from the others...
Cameron and Jane sit close together and dry off in front of the fire.
So you're never going to date anyone?
I didn't say that. I just want the guy I start dating seriously to be smart and politically aware.
I'd never date `you,` for instance.
Hey! I said it before... I'm a smart guy.
If you were so smart, you'd know that Sara wasn't into you.
Trust me, I figured that one out quick.
Besides... I'm not that into Sara.
He cocks an eyebrow at Jane.
What would you say if I was interested in you?
Can't say I'm not tempted...
But, Cameron... Don't think this is going anywhere.
Wouldn't dream of it.
Well, it looks like everyone managed to have an interesting time on their night out!

nodes.subtitle: Can Sara figure out her feelings for Nick?

nodes.text: It's early in the morning, and Sara is in the pool in the swim center.
The water is cold, but she slices through it, moving as fast as she can.
She touches the far end of the pool and surfaces.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Huff... Huff...
On the side, Coach Kessler frowns at her.

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: I was hoping that a morning practice without all the other swimmers on the team would help you focus more.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: But you've gained at least half a second since last week.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: It's like you're not even trying. What's going on?

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's nothing, Dad...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: `Coach.`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]Coach.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: It's nothing, `Coach.`
nodes.text_bbcode: It's nothing, [color=#3b78e2][i]Coach.[/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Then why aren't you performing at your peak? The championship finals are tomorrow morning!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I'll be fine. I won the Wilson Freestyle, didn't I?

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: The Swimming State Championship is much more important than the Wilson Freestyle.

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Let's go one more time. Get your act together!
Sara steps onto the starting block. She looks down at the water, trying to visualize her swim.
But her thoughts soon wander...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I thought I'd be okay that Nick and I were just friends...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: But I seem to be more distracted by it than ever...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: On my mark... Get set...

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: I can't stop thinking about him... And what happened with Sam...

nodes.speaker: Coach Kessler
nodes.text: Go!

nodes.speaker: Sara
nodes.text: Oh!
Sara dives into the water!
